scope.window: exact uic_no; not limited to reporting period

quality.duplicate_policy: Every source row retained. Rows sharing a report identity (BHP report_id|tracking_no|test_sequence_no; SRT report_id|tracking_no) are all flagged duplicate_report_identity and quarantined; no preferred row is selected or merged.
quality.empty_result_policy: An empty exact-UIC response ([]) is recorded as confirmed_empty: no rows were returned by the query. It does not show that no test was conducted.
